narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Sixty four ends in four, so sixty four squared ends in four.
<bookmark mark='sixteen'/>Square the last digit, and four times four is sixteen, which ends in six.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A number ending in four has a square ending in six, so that slip is wrong.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>To check, square only the last digit, and read the last digit of that answer.
<bookmark mark='full'/>If you have time, multiply one number out in full. Its last digit must agree.
